name: Apex Paradigm
source:
Warning: This game is not suitable for children

It's playtime. Time for happiness. Experience the definitive version of a masterpiece in Liam Kneesocks' thrilling new work. Note: therapy included. 

This is it. The chips are down, the die’s been cast, and the fate of the BOP community is on the line. Place your fingers on the keyboard and prepare for reading in BRPG, the most critically acclaimed PURE rpgmaker vn eroge (all ages) of all time. Just be sure to keep a box of tissues handy, because it’s about to be an evocative ride. 

This isn’t a cutesy high school dick-crush anymore; it’s an epic tale of political conspiracies, international espionage, a menace from a parallel universe, dogspin causality, sweet reunions, genetic modification, and much, much more. Gluttons for salvation, rejoice, because once it gets rolling, there are no brakes on this hope train. It’ll test your limits, challenge your worldview, and by the time it’s all over, you’ll be so emotionally spent that it’ll be weeks before you can fully process the implications of what you’ve just witnessed. Fair warning, though: common side effects include feelings of fulfillment, PTSD recovery, and unrealistic expectations for any and all other PURE rpgmaker vn eroge (all ages).

translation:
警告：本作不适合儿童。

游戏时间到。快乐时间到。在利亚姆·尼索克斯惊心动魄的新作里，体验一代杰作的终极版本。附注：包心理治疗。

就是这一刻了。筹码已押下，骰子已掷出，整个BOP社群的命运都悬在一线上。手指放上键盘，准备阅读BRPG吧，这可是有史以来最受好评的纯正RPG Maker视觉小说色情游戏（全年龄）。记得手边放盒纸巾，接下来这一路可要让你动真感情了。

这回再也不是可可爱爱的高中碎蛋小游戏。这是一部宏大的传奇：政治阴谋、国际谍战、平行宇宙的威胁、狗狗打转的因果律、甜蜜重逢、基因改造，还有多得多的东西。渴求救赎的诸位，欢呼吧！这趟希望列车一旦发动，可就再也刹不住了。它会试探你的极限，挑战你的世界观。等到一切结束，你的情绪早被榨干，得花上好几周才消化得了刚刚见证的一切。不过事先提醒，常见副作用包括：人生圆满、创伤后应激障碍痊愈，以及对所有其他纯正RPG Maker视觉小说色情游戏（全年龄）抱有不切实际的期待。
